_comment: Optional. Copy to config.json (which git ignores) only if you need it. The panel needs NO account credentials: it attaches to whatever MT5 terminal is already open and logged in.
_phone_note: Set 'lan' to true to reach the panel from your phone. The password is NOT set here — it lives in panel-password.txt, which git ignores. Keep the panel on a private network such as Tailscale; never port-forward it to the open internet.
_no_credentials_here: There is deliberately no place in this file for an account number or password. If you ever need the panel to log the terminal in itself, set MT5_LOGIN / MT5_PASSWORD / MT5_SERVER as environment variables instead — they live in your Windows session, not in a file that git can pick up.
